models_used.name: Qwen/Qwen3-14B-AWQ, revision 31c69efc29464b6bb0aee1398b5a7b50a99340c3 (the Qwen team's 4-bit AWQ quantisation of Qwen/Qwen3-14B)
models_used.weights_location_in_zip_or_download_scri: not in the zip; setup.sh downloads it from Hugging Face at the pinned revision to models/judge

hardware_assumed: 2x NVIDIA T4 16GB (one vLLM engine, tensor parallel over both cards); also runs on 1x T4 with fewer cases in flight
statement: I confirm that: (1) no closed or hosted model API is called by the solution or was used to label data or produce training data; (2) no test labels were created by hand or by a person; (3) test.csv was not read to design family-specific rules; (4) predict.py reproduces the Final Submission when run on test.csv.
notes: Model size: Update 2 lowered the limit for the final code check to 14B; the organisers then clarified on the Discussion tab that the limit is 15B total parameters, including embeddings, as listed on the model's official page, and that a quantised build of an allowed model (such as a 4-bit AWQ) counts by the original model's total. Qwen3-14B has 14.8B total parameters on its official page, so Qwen/Qwen3-14B-AWQ counts as 14.8B.
